body: This PR make the GHA CI not use Aqua 0.8.17 which fail on CI (see https://github.com/CliMA/ClimaAtmos.jl/actions/runs/35251130582/job/105303949353?pr=4811#step:6:559). Also, this PR bumps the minimum version of Julia to v1.10 since ClimaAtmos is not installable on Julia 1.9.
title: Exclude Aqua 0.8.17 and update Julia version to 1.10
